review_notes: I read the whole file. It has no new structure, class or definition that competes with a Mathlib concept. The only definitions are three private abbreviations. `FF M` is the subtype of `laurentBaseChange ...`. `adjJ'` and `RInf` are `Subring.closure` of explicit sets inside `FF (N*ℓ)`. They are specific local subrings built with the existing `Subring.closure`, so they are not parallel versions of a Mathlib notion. The private helpers are `mem_nonunits_iff_mem_and`, `mem_nonunits_iff_map_mem_nonunits`, `mem_iff_mem_of_sub_mem`, `isIntegral_iff_exists`, `exists_monic_of_integral`, `exists_monic_map` and `pow_mem_iff`. They are standalone lemmas about existing concepts (`ValuationSubring.nonunits`, `IsIntegral`, `Ideal`), so they fall under the rubric's exclusion for theorem duplication or proof shortening. `Place.HasValue.add`, `Place.HasValue.neg` and `Place.HasValue.sub` extend the project's own `Place.HasValue` API. I did not look for a Mathlib equivalent, because `Place` is a project concept and these are lemmas. I found no competing concept that would need an integration proposal, so I have no findings.
